answer.summary: 14 deterministic failures in 3 suites (PlayerLessonsAnonymousScopeTest, ScenarioLessonsApiTest, ScenarioObjectiveApiTest) return 404 where 200 is expected, and lesson counts come back 0 instead of 1. The change touches only OpenCRQ/XtmOne code, not these paths. A FAILCLOSED scope-gate line in ScenarioService.findInScope points to a tenant or table-gating problem, not a timing one. The 401 and NoHttpResponseException warnings are noise. No flake history, so this looks reproducible rather than flaky. The log does not show the cause, so confidence is low; check the scope gate config and tenant seeding before retrying.
